model_interpretation.claim: The parent’s row-column-K order walks B with a stride of n and performs no parallel work. Tiled i-k-j accumulation makes B and C accesses contiguous in the output-column loop; keeping an 8x128 C tile and 32x128 B panel active should improve locality. Static ownership of disjoint 8-row tiles can use up to eight threads for larger matrices, while serial execution below n=256 avoids parallel overhead on small cases. These are unmeasured expectations, not a speedup claim.
model_interpretation.transformations: {"files":["src/candidate.cpp"],"retained":["Zero the complete output on every call, then compute generic positive n dimensions without packing or explicit intrinsics.","Tile the row, output-column, and K loops (8x128x32) while keeping the inner output-column loop contiguous and processing K blocks in ascending order.","Use static OpenMP scheduling over disjoint row tiles for n >= 256, clamp worker count to 1..8, and use a serial path for smaller cases."]}

model_interpretation.claim: An 8x16 register-tiled AVX-512 FMA kernel should accelerate the large GEMM relative to the measured serial baseline. B-only 128x128 panels may improve reuse for larger matrices, but their per-call allocation and packing cost could offset that benefit; the same tile kernel uses direct B access below a generic two-panel threshold. A later matched-size direct-versus-packed run is needed to isolate the packing effect.
model_interpretation.transformations: {"files":["src/candidate.cpp"],"retained":["Replace fixed-size scalar GEMM with generic 8-row by 16-column output tiles and explicit AVX-512 FMA microkernel, guarded by runtime AVX-512F/FMA detection; use a scalar fallback for unsupported targets and row tails.","Assign disjoint output row/column tiles to an OpenMP team clamped to at most eight threads.","Use direct B access for dimensions below two 128-column panels; for larger dimensions, allocate a per-call 128x128 B-panel buffer, pack each K/column panel, and reuse the same microkernel across row tiles.","Initialize each output tile from zero on the first K panel and accumulate later panels, ensuring all output elements are overwritten on every invocation and handling K, row, and column tails generically."]}

items.subject: Intégration mesurée du tuilage T1 autour du noyau SIMD T2
items.objective: Demander une intégration mesurée en partant de la source T2, la plus rapide. Tester si l’ordonnancement ou le tuilage de la source T1 peut compléter le noyau SIMD de T2; ne retenir que les modifications compatibles et mesurées, sans présumer d’un gain additif. Préserver la voie T2 comme référence et valider la correction ainsi que les performances avec le protocole inchangé.
